definition: GPT-4.1 is a large language model within OpenAI's GPT series.
details: It was released on April 14, 2025. GPT-4.1 can be accessed through the OpenAI API or the OpenAI Developer Playground. Three different models were simultaneously released: GPT-4.1, GPT-4.1 mini, and GPT-4.1 nano. Since May 14, GPT-4.1 has been available for users subscribed to the ChatGPT Plus and Pro plans, and GPT-4.1 mini that replaces GPT-4o mini is available for all ChatGPT users.

explainer.lead: GPT-4.1 is a large language model in OpenAI's GPT series, released alongside mini and nano versions on April 14, 2025. Developers can use it through OpenAI's API or Developer Playground, while GPT-4.1 and GPT-4.1 mini are also available through ChatGPT.

tiers.eli5: GPT-4.1 is a computer program that works with language, such as answering questions or writing text. It comes in three versions: GPT-4.1, GPT-4.1 mini, and GPT-4.1 nano, a bit like one product being offered in different sizes. People can use it through developer tools or ChatGPT.
tiers.practitioner: Developers can access GPT-4.1 through the OpenAI API or test prompts in the OpenAI Developer Playground, choosing among GPT-4.1, GPT-4.1 mini, and GPT-4.1 nano. In ChatGPT, GPT-4.1 requires a Plus or Pro subscription, while GPT-4.1 mini is available to all users and replaces GPT-4o mini.
tiers.paperLevel: GPT-4.1 is a named large language model in OpenAI's GPT series, released on April 14, 2025 as part of a three-model release with GPT-4.1 mini and GPT-4.1 nano. It is accessed as a hosted model through the OpenAI API or Developer Playground, with selected variants also offered in ChatGPT.

explainer.example: A developer chooses GPT-4.1 nano in the OpenAI API, sends a paragraph with a request to summarize it, and receives a generated summary in response.

components.name: GPT-4.1: the main model in the release.
GPT-4.1 mini: a variant also offered to all ChatGPT users.
GPT-4.1 nano: the third variant released at the same time.
Access interfaces: the OpenAI API, Developer Playground, and ChatGPT.

flow: A user supplies a language-based request through an available interface.
The request is handled by the selected GPT-4.1 variant.
The model returns a language-based response.
explainer.origin: OpenAI released GPT-4.1, GPT-4.1 mini, and GPT-4.1 nano simultaneously on April 14, 2025. GPT-4.1 became available to ChatGPT Plus and Pro subscribers on May 14.
explainer.lineage: GPT-4.1 belongs to OpenAI's GPT series. In ChatGPT, GPT-4.1 mini replaced GPT-4o mini and became available to all users.
explainer.whyItMatters: The release provides three GPT-4.1 variants through developer tools and extends access to ChatGPT users. Its availability ranges from Plus and Pro subscriptions for GPT-4.1 to general ChatGPT access for GPT-4.1 mini.
